sentences.l2: 在企业数字化转型的进程中，数据往往分散在订单系统、客户管理系统和各类日志文件之中，格式不一，质量参差。
sentences.l1: In the course of enterprise digital transformation, data is often scattered across the order system, the customer management system and various log files, in inconsistent formats and of uneven quality.

sentences.l2: 要让这些数据真正服务于决策，就需要借助ETL流程加以整合。
sentences.l1: To make this data truly serve decision-making, it is necessary to integrate it with the help of the ETL process.

sentences.l2: ETL是抽取、转换、加载三个英文单词首字母的缩写。
sentences.l1: ETL is an abbreviation formed from the initial letters of the three English words extract, transform and load.

sentences.l2: 首先是抽取，即按照既定规则，从各个来源系统中读取所需数据，同时尽量避免干扰业务系统的正常运行。
sentences.l1: First comes extraction, that is, reading the required data from each source system according to established rules, while trying to avoid interfering with the normal operation of business systems.

sentences.l2: 其次是转换，数据工程师会对原始数据进行清洗、去重，统一日期和货币的格式，并依据业务逻辑计算出新的指标，以消除矛盾与冗余。
sentences.l1: Second comes transformation, in which data engineers clean and deduplicate the raw data, unify the formats of dates and currencies, and calculate new indicators according to business logic, so as to eliminate contradictions and redundancy.

sentences.l2: 最后是加载，经过处理的数据被写入数据仓库，供分析人员查询和生成报表。
sentences.l1: Last comes loading, in which the processed data is written into the data warehouse for analysts to query and generate reports.

sentences.l2: 这三个环节环环相扣，共同构成一条自动运转的数据管道。
sentences.l1: These three stages are interlocking and together form an automatically running data pipeline.

sentences.l2: 管道可以按小时或按天定时执行，一旦某个环节出错，系统便会发出警报，提醒技术人员及时排查，从而保障数据的准确与可靠。
sentences.l1: The pipeline can be executed on a schedule, hourly or daily, and once an error occurs in any stage, the system will issue an alert, reminding technical staff to investigate promptly, thereby ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the data.
